items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: I had a fella, a boy called Big Head Sun. He was from downtown. He was about the best mandolin player we had.

ctx.x: Did you ever hear him with guitar playing clandery? They were not together then?

No, it was all up in that Irish Channel all the time. They never played no dances or nothing like that. That's all. Who was the best mandolin player? Big Head Sun. I had a fella, a boy called Big Head Sun. He was from downtown. He was about the best mandolin player we had. Frank, now Chicken, off the bank, he was pretty good. Then after Columbia, I was right behind sitting on a mandolin. I was a good man. I played pretty. Well could Frank Landry play mandolin? Yeah, he played. He was good.

What about that other guy out there, Dierrensberg? Caffrey Dierrensberg? Do you know him? Did you know Caffrey? Caffrey? Yeah, he played. He and Percy both played banjo. Percy, Percy Alfred? No. No, Percy Dierrensberg. Oh. There were two brothers. There was a player with you from the... Well didn't he play with... Perares. Perares at the Pythian Temple. You'd know him if you saw him. Well you wouldn't recognize him now, he's dead. Anyway... If you saw his picture, you'd know him. I'll show you his picture. And…
